overlays.rationale: Expose intentionally unfinished lock and unlock stubs required by the public package API so the POSIX core evaluator can collect, and normalize missing end-of-file newlines so the upstream combined-module test preserves source boundaries. No operating-system locking, exception translation, timeout, lifecycle, or other implementation behavior is supplied.

Restore only the two runtime class-definition prerequisites described by the public source: with_typehint uses object at runtime and FrozenDict exposes an intentionally unfinished _immutable stub. No query, storage, table, database, or middleware behavior is supplied.

Restore only mechanical import/parse prerequisites so the stripped Requests source can collect tests: the SOCKS import fallback body and placeholder definitions for internally imported _copy_cookie_jar, default_hooks, and super_len. No SOCKS fallback function, adapter behavior, session behavior, request preparation, response handling, cookie behavior, hook dispatch, body-length behavior, or utility behavior is supplied.

Restore only the missing status_codes._init symbol and the five redirect aliases needed by requests.models.REDIRECT_STATI during package import. The full status-code lookup table is not populated by the overlay.
Make extract_zipped_paths return its input path so adapter TLS context preload receives a filesystem path during package import. Zip extraction and path-materialization behavior remain unfinished.

Expose only the package-import setup() hook that parsel.__init__ calls, delegating to the already stripped set_xpathfunc('has-class', has_class) implementation. No XPath extension registration behavior, has-class semantics, selector behavior, CSS translation, or utility behavior is supplied.

Restore only the hatch-vcs generated fsspec._version module needed by fsspec.__init__ during direct checkout test execution. No filesystem, registry, core, utility, cache, or compression behavior is supplied.

Expose only missing utility symbols imported by public modules and tests: is_exception, isfilelike, get_protocol, _unstrip_protocol, setup_logging, and nullcontext. The functions are intentionally unfinished placeholders.
Expose only import-time compression callables noop_file, unzip, and zstandard_file so compression.py can import. Compression registration and codec behavior remain unfinished.
Expose only missing core symbols get_compression and _expand_paths required by local imports and public tests. Path expansion and compression inference behavior remain unfinished.

Expose only missing public utility symbols imported by fields/schema tests: timestamp helpers, ISO helpers, text coercion, awareness checks, and unknown-parameter validation. Most helper bodies remain intentionally unfinished stubs.

Allow SchemaMeta class construction by returning empty field/hook structures from stripped metaclass helpers. Field declaration, schema option, load, dump, and hook execution behavior remains unfinished.
Provide only the minimal iterable collection predicate needed for public schema fixtures and Nested field construction to import. Full utility behavior remains unfinished.
Make public decorators return the decorated function with minimal hook metadata so test modules can collect. Processor invocation, validation, load, and dump behavior remains unfinished.
Expose only util symbols imported by lexer/client modules and public tests: assert_imap_protocol, to_bytes, to_unicode, and chunk. The helper bodies remain unfinished placeholders.

Allow public class/module construction by making require_capability an identity decorator and exposing datetime_to_native as an unfinished placeholder. Capability checks and datetime normalization remain unfinished.
Expose only the iteritems name used by _dict_bytes_normaliser during class construction. Dictionary normalization behavior remains unfinished.
Expose version string, quota parsing, and search normalization helper names imported by public tests. The helper bodies remain unfinished placeholders.
Expose text-list and parenthesized-string helper names imported by public utility tests. Text normalization behavior remains unfinished.
Expose only SpawnBase._get_buffer and SpawnBase._set_buffer placeholders so the stripped class-level buffer property can bind during public test collection. Buffer semantics remain unfinished.
